en.text:
While Arc Conductor is active: 
Gain 10% increased damage, 100 Handling, and each shot fired has a 33% chance to fully <title refill [G_refill] /> the magazine.

Scoring 2 to 3 hits within 0.2 seconds of each other causes the target to chain 'weak' lightning to the closest enemy within an 8 meter radius for <pve 22 /> <pvp [?] /> damage.

Enemies hit by this 'weak' lightning release multiple stronger chains of lightning around them, striking up to 4 targets in an 8 meter radius for <pve 28 /> <pvp [?] /> damage.

The stronger chains of lightning only target enemies that haven't been hit by them for 0.33 seconds.
